title: Calibration provided via syringe icon doesn't reset calibration timer.
symptom: When resolving a calibration error using the syringe icon, the calibration timer for regular calibrations does not get reset, even though the calibration is accepted by the transmitter. The user has 12hr calibrations and needs to enter via the menu calibration option to have the timer reset.
fix: The issue was resolved in the 26th May nightly release, as stated by jamorham.
evidence_quote: I think this issue should be resolved in the 26th May nightly.
